sandbox.title: Sandbox Security
sandbox.enabledDesc: When enabled, all AI execution is governed by file, command, and network security rules
sandbox.fileDesc: Manage file read/write permissions and allow/block lists
sandbox.commandDesc: Manage allow/ask/block lists for shell commands
sandbox.networkDesc: Manage network requests and domain lists

dataSafety.title: Data Safety
dataSafety.backupDesc: Automatically back up files before each conversational modification
dataSafety.deleteProtectionDesc: Deleted files go to the trash instead of being permanently removed
dataSafety.bulkThresholdDesc: Pause and ask for confirmation when deleting more files than this threshold
dataSafety.invalidThreshold: Threshold must be an integer between 1 and 99999

audit.title: Audit Center
audit.clearDesc: This deletes all security operation logs and cannot be undone.

events.command-safety_cwd-fallback: Working directory out of bounds, fell back: {{requested}}
